Markets.title: Buyback alert: GE Shipping to repurchase shares at 16% premium
Markets.summary: Great Eastern Shipping plans to repurchase up to 58.82 lakh shares, representing 4.12% of its paid-up equity capital, through an open market buyback worth up to Rs 900 crore. The maximum buyback price is set at Rs 1,530 per share, which is a 15.99% premium over the stock's previous close.

Markets.title: Bombay Burmah Trading among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
Markets.summary: Four Nifty500 stocks, including Bombay Burmah, gained over 4% as their RSI crossed above 50. This technical indicator shift signals strengthening momentum for these companies.

Markets.title: ESDS Software Solution IPO opens today; GMP signals 76% premium — Should you subscribe?
Markets.summary: ESDS Software Solution has launched its Rs 720-crore initial public offering with a price band of Rs 408 to Rs 429 per share, with the subscription window open from August 28 to September 1, 2026. The entirely fresh issue of 1.68 crore shares is currently signaling a 76% premium in the grey market.

Markets.title: Priority Jewels IPO opens today: GMP signals 19% listing gain. Should you subscribe?
Markets.summary: Priority Jewels launched its three-day IPO on August 28, 2026, with the grey market indicating a 19% listing gain. The company raised Rs 27.45 crore from anchor investors to primarily repay debt and fund general corporate needs.

Markets.title: Why WhiteOak CIO Ramesh Mantri prefers REITs, InvITs over high dividend yield stocks
Markets.summary: WhiteOak CIO Ramesh Mantri favors REITs and InvITs over high dividend yield stocks because they must distribute at least 90% of their net cash flows. This ensures that a large portion of the portfolio's returns comes from contractual, rent- or toll-linked income rather than market sentiment.

Markets.title: HCL Tech Share Price Live Updates: HCL Tech Sees a -2.76% Drop in Weekly Returns
Markets.summary: HCL Tech experienced a 2.76% decrease in its weekly returns. The stock's recent market performance reflects this downward movement.

Geo-Political.title: Collapsed glacier likely caused devastating Nepal-Tibet floods, scientists say
Geo-Political.summary: Scientists report that a collapsed glacier likely caused the devastating floods in the Nepal-Tibet region. This event highlights the growing dangers associated with rapidly melting ice in the Himalayas.

Geo-Political.title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
Geo-Political.summary: Deadly flooding and landslides occurred on Wednesday along the border of Nepal and Tibet. Hundreds of people have died or are currently missing as a result of the disaster.

Geo-Political.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
Geo-Political.summary: Ratko Mladić, the convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal, has died at the age of 84. He was serving a life sentence given in 2017 for genocide and crimes against humanity committed during the 1990s Yugoslav wars.

Geo-Political.title: Jury deliberating in trial of Lindsay Clancy, US woman accused of killing her children
Geo-Political.summary: A jury is deliberating in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, a U.S. woman accused of killing her three children. Prosecutors argued she planned the murders, while her defense argued she was suffering from postpartum psychosis.

Geo-Political.title: Norwegians lay flowers at palace as King Harald's condition worsens
Geo-Political.summary: Citizens in Norway are leaving flowers at the royal palace as 89-year-old King Harald remains in the hospital with an extremely serious medical condition. Family members have gathered at the hospital to visit the ailing monarch.

Geo-Political.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
Geo-Political.summary: Board of Peace Gaza envoy Nickolay Mladenov has criticized both Israeli airstrikes and Hamas actions. He warned that the collapse of last October's ceasefire would create a point of no return for the region.

Data & Insights.title: Not just the farmer, PSBs may soon fund entire farm value chains
Data & Insights.summary: A government proposal suggests public sector banks shift from lending to individual farmers to funding entire farm value chains based on key district products. This cluster-based lending plan will connect farmers and Farmer Producer Organizations with processors, storage facilities, and logistics businesses.

Data & Insights.title: India, Canada seek to deepen economic cooperation beyond trade through investment, finance and capital markets
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada held their inaugural Economic and Financial Dialogue to strengthen ties beyond traditional trade. Their finance ministers discussed domestic macroeconomic stability, financial integration, and cooperation on critical minerals.

Data & Insights.title: Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech: 5 key things markets expect to hear from new Fed chief on 28 August
Data & Insights.summary: Markets are awaiting Kevin Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole speech to understand his approach to monetary policy and inflation. Although his past comments indicate a cautious stance on rate increases, investors remain uncertain about his specific methods for measuring inflation.

Data & Insights.title: India-Japan ties gain momentum after Piyush Goyal’s Japan visit
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal visited Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka to boost Japanese investment in India. The visit aimed to strengthen industrial partnerships and build resilient supply chains between the two countries.

Data & Insights.title: South leads in India’s festive hiring market: Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai remain primary employment hubs
Data & Insights.summary: Southern India is projected to account for 36.3% of the country's festive frontline jobs in 2026. Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Chennai will serve as the primary employment hubs driving this growth.

Data & Insights.title: Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole test: Can the new Fed chief tame inflation without triggering a bond-market shock?
Data & Insights.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh must convince markets at Jackson Hole that he will control inflation without increasing bond market pressures. This presents a difficult challenge for his leadership in managing monetary policy and market stability.

India.title: Opinion: Meta Pays Billions Over Teen Harms In US. In India, Algo Runs Unchecked
India.summary: The US Surgeon General warned that heavy social media use roughly doubles adolescents' risk of depression and anxiety while worsening body image for nearly half of teens. Meanwhile, Meta faces billions in US penalties for teen harms, while its algorithms operate unchecked in India.

India.title: Gym Trainer Who Stabbed Delhi Model At Home Arrested After Encounter
India.summary: A gym trainer named Imran was arrested following an encounter for allegedly stabbing a Delhi model named Muskan at her home. A friend stated that Imran had been pursuing Muskan for a long time despite her family's warnings about the harassment.

India.title: NIT Rourkela Records 1,340 Job Offers; BTech Student Gets Rs 1.31 Crore Package
India.summary: NIT Rourkela concluded its 2025-26 placement season with 1,340 job offers and 364 internship opportunities across various sectors. A BTech student received the highest package of Rs 1.31 crore.

India.title: Hours Before His Murder, Haryanvi Singer Ankit Balyan Sang About Killing
India.summary: Haryanvi singer and YouTuber Ankit Balyan posted an Instagram video singing lines from his song "Baby Badmash" that mentioned murder. Hours later, he was shot and killed on the road.

India.title: Thane Woman's Bank Account Used In Cyber Fraud Cases, She Dies By Suicide
India.summary: Police from Rajasthan visited a Thane woman's home on August 8 because her bank account was used in cyber fraud cases. Following the visit, she died by suicide.

India.title: In A First, Vijay Leaves Chief Minister's Seat, Sits With Ministers In Assembly
India.summary: During an afternoon session of the assembly, Vijay moved from his seat next to the Speaker. He sat down between Minister K A Sengottaiyan and Aadhav Arjuna.

General.title: Watch: Tracing the deadly path of the Nepal-Tibet flash flood
General.summary: BBC Verify used verified videos to trace the destructive path of a flash flood between Nepal and Tibet. The disaster resulted in significant damage and casualties along its route.

General.title: Extra 200 police drafted in to aid force investigating wrong-way crash and fire deaths
General.summary: Cleveland Police has received support from six local forces and the National Crime Agency. An extra 200 police officers have been drafted in to aid the investigation into a wrong-way crash and fire deaths.

General.title: Clean-up of illegal waste supersite costs taxpayers £6m
General.summary: Taxpayers paid £6 million to clean up an illegal waste supersite in Oxfordshire. The cost of clearing the massive dump was entirely covered by public funds.

General.title: NHS bosses warn of chaos in ADHD and autism care
General.summary: Costs are spiralling out of control as unregulated private providers capitalise on demand, say managers.

General.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
General.summary: Following the collapse of trade talks between the United States and Canada, President Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America.
